readsAs: three tilted rounded bars, like a skewed equals sign or hamburger menu
a stepped, abstract S or a zigzag
a mid-gap spacer between two slabs, a loose hint at a seam
judge.why: Clean and reproducible in one colour, but three tilted pill-bars are a stock motif; the concept is called "overlap" yet nothing overlaps or joins, so the seam idea doesn't come through, and at 16–24 px the small middle bar turns into noise.
